releaseNotes:
v0.2.10

- OTA update: instant feedback when 지금 설치 is tapped — the dialog switches to
  an indeterminate progress bar immediately, then the %/MB bar once the
  download size is known. No more dead gap after pressing install.
- OTA update: the admin idle timer no longer closes Settings (and cancels the
  download) while an update is downloading or installing.

No water-dispense change.
